name: robo_rebalance_after_withdrawal_with_sale_costs
question_template: A fictional robo-advisor manages a two-asset account holding {EQUITY} USD in equities and {BONDS} USD in bonds, with a target equity weight of {TARGET} percent of total account value. Every sale costs {COST} percent of the gross amount sold; the cost is deducted from the sale proceeds, so a gross sale of G reduces that holding by G and yields G times (1 minus cost ratio) in cash. Purchases are free. First the client receives a cash withdrawal of {WITHDRAW} USD, funded entirely by a gross bond sale sized so that its net proceeds equal the withdrawal exactly. Then the advisor compares the post-withdrawal equity weight with the target: if equity is overweight it sells equity and reinvests all net proceeds in bonds; if underweight it sells bonds and reinvests all net proceeds in equities; if exactly on target it trades nothing. The gross rebalancing sale is sized so that, after its sale cost, the equity holding is exactly the target weight of the post-rebalance total. What is the total account value after the rebalance in USD?

slots.description: Gross bond sale needed to deliver the withdrawal net of cost.
Equity weight of the account immediately after the withdrawal.
Signed change in equity holding from rebalancing, positive means buy.

program:
def solve():
    E = Fraction(P["EQUITY"])
    B = Fraction(P["BONDS"])
    w = Fraction(P["TARGET"]) / 100
    c = Fraction(P["COST"]) / 100
    W = Fraction(P["WITHDRAW"])
    gross_bond = W / (1 - c)
    if gross_bond > B:
        raise ValueError("bond holding insufficient to fund withdrawal")
    E1 = E
    B1 = B - gross_bond
    T1 = E1 + B1
    weight1 = E1 / T1
    if weight1 > w:
        x = (E1 - w * T1) / (1 - w * c)
        trade = -x
        total = T1 - c * x
    elif weight1 < w:
        y = (w * T1 - E1) / (1 - c + w * c)
        trade = y * (1 - c)
        total = T1 - c * y
    else:
        trade = Fraction(0)
        total = T1
    return {
        "final": total,
        "withdrawal_gross_sale": gross_bond,
        "post_withdrawal_weight": weight1 * 100,
        "equity_trade": trade
    }
